data.narrative: Completed Module 2 learning log literacy - chose minimal logging strategy (WARN and above) for cost efficiency, diagnosed timezone mismatch bug (UTC vs local time in database), identified log injection vulnerability where user input with newlines can forge log entries, implemented input sanitization to prevent injection attacks.

dimension_scores.observation: Formed testable hypothesis for timezone bug - application uses UTC while database stores local time, causing links to fall into query gap around midnight. Verified by comparing log timestamps vs database timestamps.
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_timezone_bug.md explains root cause as timezone mismatch between UTC application and local database

dimension_scores.observation: Read logs as timeline following request IDs, identified log injection attack by noticing missing request received line for r-102 and embedded newline in URL field. Reconstructed request r-004 timeline showing 700ms duration with slow db write.
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_log_injection_bug.md identifies forged log by missing request ID and embedded newline. module2_verification.md reconstructs request timeline.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified that timezone bug is time-dependent and intermittent (links return 404 for few hours around midnight). Recognized log injection can be reproduced by submitting URL with newline and embedded JSON.
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_timezone_bug.md describes intermittent time-dependent bug. module2_log_injection_fix.md provides test case with newline injection.

dimension_scores.observation: Module 2 did not exercise communication under pressure - this dimension is introduced in Module 05 for incident response. Set baseline score as no evidence yet.
dimension_scores.evidence: No incident communication performed in Module 2 - focused on log analysis and individual debugging.

dimension_scores.observation: Traced timezone bug beyond immediate symptom to systemic cause - two systems using different time conventions (UTC vs local) with no validation at boundary. Proposed systemic fix: normalize all timestamps to UTC in storage, convert at display layer only.
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_timezone_bug.md explains why mismatch exists (different time conventions) and proposes systemic fix.

dimension_scores.observation: Module 2 did not exercise postmortem quality - this dimension is introduced in Module 07. Set baseline score as no evidence yet.
dimension_scores.evidence: No postmortem analysis performed in Module 2 - focused on debugging technique.

strengths: Chose minimal logging strategy with reasoning about cost ($1,000/day at scale) and cognitive overload
Identified log injection attack by analyzing log structure (missing request ID, embedded newline)
Understood timezone bug is time-dependent and affects systems with non-zero offset
Proposed systemic fixes: input sanitization for logs, UTC normalization for timestamps
data.recommendation: Continue to Module 03 to develop reproduction skills - isolating variables, creating minimal reproduction cases, and distinguishing flaky from deterministic failures.

public_evidence.student_action: Identified log injection where URL field contains newline character and embedded fake JSON log entry, implemented input sanitization to remove control characters before logging, verified fix by submitting malicious URL and confirming it appears as single string value not separate log entry
public_evidence.technical_detail: Added sanitize_for_logging() function to remove control characters, applied in api/app/services.py before logging user input
public_evidence.ability: Log security and input sanitization to prevent log injection attacks
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates ability to identify security vulnerabilities in logging infrastructure, understand attack vectors (newline injection), and implement defensive programming with input validation

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: module2_verification.md reconstructs request timeline from logs, identifies missing log lines
module2_log_injection_bug.md identifies forged log by embedded newline in URL field
module2_timezone_bug.md explains UTC vs local time mismatch and proposes UTC storage

values understanding why over just fixing how
